confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Sydney prices for a July 2026 window; no live listings or price pages were inspected. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies more with season and venue. FX provenance: the 0.6955 value came from search-result summaries of the RBA homepage (rba.gov.au/) for 15 October 2026; I did not open that page, and the RBA exchange-rates statistics page returned only an older cached snapshot. A third-party figure of 0.6947 for 16 October was not used because it is not an RBA source and the 16 October RBA fixing may not yet be published.
comparable_city_reasoning: No formal comparable-city lookup was performed. Estimates are based on Sydney's general position as a high-cost Australian coastal capital, broadly in line with Melbourne and Auckland for restaurants and drinks, with accommodation set for a winter (non-summer) window.
